CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reset_guard_screen()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.guard_screen_status
  set current_status = 'READY',
      employee_name = null,
      employee_id = null,
      message = 'QR جاهز للمسح',
      updated_at = now()
  where id = 1;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true);
end;
$function$
